01 — CHARACTER PROFILE

About me

THE PERSON BEHIND THE CODE, THE RESEARCH, AND THE CREATIVE WORK

Curious by nature, creative by choice.

Hello! I’m Reba Dixie C. Somngi, a first-year Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (BSCS) student at the University of the Cordilleras. I’m currently based in La Trinidad, Benguet.

I’m an ambivert with a curious and creative personality. I enjoy exploring technology, learning programming, playing games, and discovering new interests. I also appreciate teamwork and enjoy connecting with people while maintaining time for my own interests.

I’m interested in how technology, research, and creativity can come together to turn ideas into meaningful work.
